children: JGBs edge lower in price terms amid rising oil prices that typically lead to higher inflation in Japan, which could spur a quicker pace of BOJ rate increases. "The key question is whether markets bring forward the BoJ rate-hike path further or continue to unwind recent repricing," two members of J.P. Morgan's Japan Markets Research say in a recent research report. "While a September hike still appears likely, the main focus is how USD/JPY developments shape the pricing of the BoJ rate-hike path," they add. The ten-year JGB yield is up 0.5 bp at 2.910%. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
